_comment: Images built by CI (.github/workflows/build-images.yml), read by .github/scripts/plan-builds.py.
context:    folder with the Dockerfile; a change to a non-.md file here rebuilds the image.
image:      Docker Hub repository name (pushed under the DOCKERHUB_USERNAME account).
tag_prefix: put in front of every tag (latest, previous, YYYY-MM-DD, sha-<commit>).
parent:     the image in this list it is built FROM; it is rebuilt whenever the parent is.
opt_in:     never built by the monthly schedule, tags or 'all'; only when named or its own files change.
Adding an image: one entry here, plus its name in the Retag workflow's image list.
